verdict.rationale: Brex's marketing claims "AI-powered automation of invoice entry, approval, and payments" within its bill pay product, which maps directly to AI reading bills and entering their details with an approval step. The claim is a single marketing line with no documentation of how extraction or the review workflow works. Missing for 10: documentation of AI extraction of specific payment fields (vendor, amount, bank details, due date) from incoming bills, an explicit human-review step before payment, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have AI read incoming bills and auto-populate payment details for my review

citations.quote: Save time with AI-powered automation of invoice entry, approval, and payments.
Brex is the first fully unified spend platform — with global corporate cards, expense management, reimbursements, travel, and bill pay.
